conditional_scenarios.title: Scarcity and purchase authorization
conditional_scenarios.trigger: A documented local shortfall persists and the responsible authority announces an allocation scheme.
conditional_scenarios.conditional_projection: Persistent shortages can be followed by broader quota or credential requirements in the affected jurisdiction.
conditional_scenarios.observations_required: Archive the actual order, commodity, effective dates, issuer, eligible categories, denial rule, exemptions, appeal route and sunset clause. Compare with that same jurisdiction's September baseline.
conditional_scenarios.alternative_or_nonconfirmation: Restored ordinary sales, an expired scheme or sufficient imports would not support an expansion claim. A retailer loyalty card or optional discount card is not a mandatory authorization.

conditional_scenarios.title: Whether emergency credentials expand or expire
conditional_scenarios.trigger: An identified mandatory fuel or food authorization remains in use after its original emergency period.
conditional_scenarios.conditional_projection: A lasting access system would require evidence of renewal, expanded coverage or additional eligibility conditions, rather than merely the original temporary card.
conditional_scenarios.observations_required: Track renewal orders and the exact conditions under which an otherwise eligible purchaser is refused. Separately document any political, religious or behavioral condition rather than inferring it from identification.
conditional_scenarios.alternative_or_nonconfirmation: A need-based quota with open eligibility, review and an effective sunset can remain emergency allocation without the allegiance mechanism examined in Revelation 13.

conditional_scenarios.title: Lagged food-affordability and agricultural effects
conditional_scenarios.trigger: Fuel, transport or fertilizer disruption persists into an identified production or delivery cycle.
conditional_scenarios.conditional_projection: The existing fuel-to-food mechanism projects later pressure on basic-diet affordability or agricultural operations, even after the initial pump-price jump.
conditional_scenarios.observations_required: Begin with Sudan's WFP basic-diet series and separately documented affected food-delivery or farming operations. Record planting dates, input use, wages, harvest volumes and relief access; fix each geographical comparison before reviewing outcomes.
conditional_scenarios.alternative_or_nonconfirmation: Improved transport, aid, imports, subsidies or substitute inputs can interrupt the chain. A worldwide famine claim needs worldwide evidence and cannot be inferred from one local series.

conditional_scenarios.title: Supply routes and the next energy observations
conditional_scenarios.trigger: Renewed hostilities or documented transport restrictions continue to constrain the same export routes.
conditional_scenarios.conditional_projection: Continued route disruption would keep supply and logistics under pressure; reopening and sustained flows provide the competing recovery pathway.
conditional_scenarios.observations_required: Compare successive IEA Gulf and Russian export estimates, route restrictions, inventory changes and the same AAA diesel series. Keep production, net exports, wholesale prices and retail averages separate.
conditional_scenarios.alternative_or_nonconfirmation: A ceasefire accompanied by verified route recovery and improving supply would not support a continuing-disruption projection.

conditional_scenarios.title: AI agreements and observable implementation
conditional_scenarios.trigger: The United States and China announce a new AI-related agreement or joint undertaking with identifiable commitments.
conditional_scenarios.conditional_projection: The author predicts that a deal will not end competing development. A prospective test must specify what the agreement actually promises to stop, limit, disclose or verify.
conditional_scenarios.observations_required: Preserve the signed text, implementation dates, verification provisions and documented development actions. Plan a review six months after the actual agreement; the review date here is only a check for whether a qualifying agreement exists.
conditional_scenarios.alternative_or_nonconfirmation: Continued AI research is not a breach when the agreement permits it. Verified compliance or effective risk reduction must be recorded alongside violations and unresolved claims.

conditional_scenarios.title: Independent AI capability and military escalation
conditional_scenarios.trigger: The author's proposed multiple-singularity condition is operationally defined and supported by independently assessable capability evidence.
conditional_scenarios.conditional_projection: The supplied posts anticipate nuclear war after multi-polar AI singularities. This register preserves that forecast but does not add an event date or turn it into an established causal law.
conditional_scenarios.observations_required: Define capability thresholds before evaluating them. Separately record military integration, diplomatic changes, alerts and any independently confirmed use of nuclear weapons in conflict. Routine tests, rhetoric and product announcements are different observations.
conditional_scenarios.alternative_or_nonconfirmation: Multiple capable AI systems coexisting with de-escalation would matter to the proposed causal sequence. The original deadline is absent, so a review date is not a falsification deadline and the forecast is not presently a time-bounded test.
